notes.title: [NEW] Space Update!
notes.notes:
Hey all! 

We have decided to release a new space re-skin of the game called "Flipped On EXTREAM". The re-skin is a brand new build that contains 7 new levels and 2 new functions that the car is able to preform, Boosting and Breaking!
(3 More levels are currently being worked on)

Flipped On EXTREAM - Does not support mac how ever the base game will work on mac.

Flipped On EXTREAM does not cost extra you just need to buy the base game.


Go flip your car and have a great time!!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/769910/Flipped_On/

notes.title: Flipped On - New Mac Release
notes.notes:
Hey all. We have just launched our Mac build on Steam. 

The game has been such a success that the the team and i decided to create a Mac build for anyone who has Steam on that platform.

We have also updated the ICON of the game for the windows build so there will be a small update.

Thanks
Four Winged Studio
